01 / Context

When a form asks too much, too soon.

This concept explores a common dealership lead-generation problem: a seven-field form asks for contact information before communicating what a shopper will receive. The prototype compares that baseline with an intent-first flow.

The proposed research plan combines GA4 funnel exploration, call-quality review, and usability sessions to understand both abandonment and downstream lead quality.

Problem: Make the mobile quote path easier to complete without sacrificing the purchase-intent context that business development reps need.
02 / Constraints

Real constraints shape the solution.

AThird-party dealership CMS and embedded components.
BConsent language subject to legal approval.
CExisting BDC lead routing and callback process.
DGA4 and Google Ads conversion tracking needed to remain consistent during testing.
03 / Decision

Qualify first. Ask for contact last.

The design considers three options: a shorter one-page form, a three-step intent-first form, and a call-only page. The stepped design balanced the needs of after-hours shoppers, sales teams, and lead quality.

Option ATrim the formLower implementation cost, but still asked for contact details too early.
Option B · SelectedIntent-first flowVehicle, then timing, then contact. Clear value proposition and an optional call path.
Option CCall-onlyDirect for ready-to-buy customers, but excludes many after-hours leads.
04 / Prototype

Try the lead experience.

An illustrative interactive prototype, not a dealership-integrated form. Nothing is sent.

Event log · local demo
Prototype ready.

Each step emits a form-step event. The measurement plan reconciles these with CRM lead quality.

05 / Outcome

Designed for measurable lead quality.

The proposed measurement plan specifies form-step events, field errors, click-to-call placement, and lead-quality values that could be reconciled with CRM data. This is a design concept; post-launch results have not been measured.

Primary measurementMobile form completion rate and cost per qualified lead.
Quality measurementBDC-qualified call rate, purchase timing, and downstream appointments.
06 / Reflection

What I would improve.

Recruit first-time dealership shoppers; define a more complete step-level baseline before launch; and test softer labels for shoppers who are still researching.
